title: "lang_mappings"
format: html
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import re

lex = pd.read_csv("lex_ref_link.csv", low_memory=False)
m   = pd.read_csv("lang_abbrev_master.csv")

# 1) explode source_abbrev variants -> dict: token -> eng_abbrev
token_to_eng = {}
for _, row in m.iterrows():
    eng = row["eng_abbrev"]
    src = "" if pd.isna(row["source_abbrev"]) else str(row["source_abbrev"])
    for tok in src.split(","):
        tok = tok.strip()
        if tok:
            token_to_eng[tok] = eng

split_re = re.compile(r"[;,/]|(?:\s+)")

def normalize_token(t: str) -> str:
    t = t.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    t = t.lstrip("-").strip()
    return t

def expand_tokens(raw: str):
    if pd.isna(raw) or not str(raw).strip():
        return []
    s = re.sub(r"[()\[\]{}]", " ", str(raw))
    toks = [normalize_token(t) for t in split_re.split(s) if t and t.strip()]
    out = []
    for t in toks:
        if not t:
            continue
        if t in token_to_eng:
            out.append(t)
        elif "-" in t and t not in token_to_eng:
            # split compound chains like nhd.-bair.-österr.
            parts = [normalize_token(p) for p in t.split("-") if p]
            out.extend([p for p in parts if p])
        else:
            out.append(t)
    return out

def map_to_eng(raw: str):
    mapped = []
    for t in expand_tokens(raw):
        if t in token_to_eng:
            mapped.append(token_to_eng[t])
    return mapped

lex["eng_abbrev_list"] = lex["orig_lang_abbrev"].apply(map_to_eng)

```
